definition: Iteration closes eligible lists under adjoining any Form of the admitted quality. Combined with ordinary self-predication, the enlarged list is again homogeneous. This is a universal research reconstruction of the repeated step in Parmenides132b, not an axiom about every Platonic reading.
note: Explicit semantic boundary for issue #258. The cited primary readings motivate research premises without defining this modern finite-list encoding. A sourced replacement would need to settle precisely these quantifiers, domains and predication senses.
